probe.unsupported: No issues found. This API type has no automatic connection check.

rules.noAccess: No role grants access. This service is unreachable by any key.
rules.deprecated: Marked deprecated. Migrate consumers off this service.
rules.cannotConnect: Cannot reach this service. Check its host and credentials.

overview.description: Your API is live. Copy a request and run it.

serviceType.label: Service Type
serviceType.tooltip: Select the type of service you're adding.

namespace.label: Namespace
namespace.tooltip: Select a namespace used for the API’s URI structure, such as /api/v2/{type}/{namespace}. It should be lowercase and alphanumeric.
namespace.hint: This becomes the URL segment for the generated API, like /api/v2/your-namespace. Use lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores.

label.label: Label
label.tooltip: The display name or label for the service.

description.label: Description
description.tooltip: Write a brief description of the API (optional).

firstTimeGuidance: This is your first API. We'll walk you through the security configuration that protects it.
createSuccessMsg: Service created. Generate its API docs to try it out, or lock it down with a role.

celebration.title: Your first API is live
celebration.subtitle: {{name}} is ready to use
celebration.whatHappened: Here's what just happened in under 1 second:

database.title: Connected to Database
database.description: Established secure connection and analyzed your database schema

endpoints.title: Generated REST API Endpoints
endpoints.description: Created full CRUD operations for all tables with pagination & filtering

security.title: Applied Security Configuration
security.description: Set up role-based access control with your specified permissions

apiKey.title: Generated API Key
apiKey.description: Created a secure API key for authentication

celebration.usageHint: Add the API key to the 'X-DreamFactory-Api-Key' header in your requests

access.title: Who can reach this service
access.description: Every role is a row, every HTTP verb a column. Green is full access, amber is filtered, muted is none. Derived live from the role graph.
access.hint: Agents and API keys inherit these grants through their role. Click any granted cell to see exactly what that role can reach across the platform.

dialog.title: {{verb}} on {{service}}
dialog.hint: This is everything the role reaches, not just this service. Grants marked inherited come from a wildcard rule; explicit grants target one service. Edit the role to change what agents and keys under it can touch.

pipeline.title: The request pipeline
pipeline.description: The ordered chain every request runs before it reaches your data. Each step deep-links to the config that governs it.
pipeline.hint: Derived live from keys, roles, and limits. Open steps are policies you have not set yet.

curlImport.buttonHint: Prefill the base URL, parameters and headers from a cURL command.
curlImport.title: Import from cURL
curlImport.hint: Paste a cURL command. The URL, query parameters, headers and supported CURL options are mapped onto this service's configuration. Nothing is saved until you save the service.

semantic.title: What agents should know about this data
semantic.description: Business terms, metrics and verified questions for this service. Approved entries reach AI agents inside the MCP data model; drafts and stale entries never do.

empty.title: Teach agents what this data means
empty.description: Add glossary terms, metrics and verified questions so AI agents read your business language instead of guessing from column names. Only entries you approve are sent to agents, inside the data model they request over MCP.

delete.title: Delete entry
delete.message: Delete "{{name}}"? Agents stop receiving it immediately if it was approved.

validate.ok: Checked {{checked}} approved entries against the live schema. All still match.
validate.stale: Checked {{checked}} approved entries. {{count}} no longer match the schema and are now stale:

hint.term: A glossary entry: what a business word means here, and optionally which table, column or value it refers to.
hint.metric: A named aggregate. Agents run it with the aggregate_data tool using exactly these arguments.
hint.query: A question you have checked, with the request that answers it. Agents run it with the get_table_data tool.

editor.backToDraftNote: Changing the definition sends this entry back to draft; a name or description change keeps its status.
editor.name: Name
editor.descriptionHint: Optional note for admins and agents.
editor.synonymsHint: Press Enter or comma after each synonym.
editor.mapsTo: Maps to a table or column
editor.valueHint: The stored value this term stands for, e.g. shipped.
editor.question: Question
editor.questionHint: Phrase it the way a user would ask it.
editor.fieldsHint: Leave empty to return every field.
editor.filterHint: DreamFactory filter syntax. Use {name} for a value the agent supplies, and declare it below.
editor.relatedHint: Relationships to include with each row.
editor.paramsHint: None. Add one for each {placeholder} in the filter.
editor.undeclared: The filter uses {{names}} but no parameter declares it.
editor.unused: Declared but not used in the filter: {{names}}.

preview.title: What agents see for {{service}}
preview.hint: This is the semantics block MCP get_data_model returns for this service. Only approved entries are included.
preview.empty: Nothing yet. Approve an entry and it appears here.
